title: Black Bean Tacos
description: Smoky beans, quick pickled onion, and warm corn tortillas.
imageAlt: Black bean tacos with pink pickled onions and lime

steps.title: Pickle the onion
steps.text: Toss the onion with the lime juice and a big pinch of salt. Let stand while you cook.

steps.title: Cook the beans
steps.text: Warm the oil in a skillet over medium. Cook the garlic, cumin, and paprika for 30 seconds. Add the beans and water and simmer 10 minutes, mashing some.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Char the tortillas over a flame or in a dry pan.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spoon in the beans and top with avocado, cotija, onion, and cilantro.
